description: Which centralised exchanges a wallet sent to and received from over a window, computed from our transfers joined to the addresses the chain's label table marks as exchanges. Returns `exchanges` [{entity, sent_usd, recv_usd, sent_share, transfers, first_seen, last_seen, addresses, label_confidence, label_sources}] with USD in plain dollars (priced transfers only), and `activity` totals over ALL counterparties so shares can be checked. `pattern` is "sweeps_to_single_cex" when >=90% of the wallet's outgoing USD went to one exchange across >=3 outgoing transfers: an OBSERVED pattern, not a claim that the address is a deposit address. Exchange figures are a lower bound (an exchange address we have not labelled is invisible; labels are sparse on hyperevm) and labels are a consensus with a stated confidence, not a certainty. A very active wallet is refused with a message to narrow `window`. `found` is false when the wallet has no priced transfer in the window. Use when the user asks 'which exchanges does this wallet use' / 'does it send to an exchange'.

window.description: Look-back window (default 365d). A very active wallet may be refused over a long window: narrow it
